messages:
emma: Heads up — after today's canary (deploy: infra/2026-03-17-rc4) the latency dashboard lost p95/p99 traces for gateway-api /prod. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/abc123 :eyes:
sre-bot: Deploy infra/2026-03-17-rc4 by @nisha completed at 1776543000. Rollout-check passed, no infra alerts emitted by bot.
liam: Can you repro? Is this all routes or only gateway-api?
emma: Only gateway-api and a few downstream routes (ingestion-worker). p50/p90 still present, tails gone. Customers reporting higher tail latency but dashboard shows nothing :thinking_face:
nisha: I pushed a change to metrics aggregation to collapse empty series when we normalize tags — might be accidentally filtering high-quantile series. PR #8764 changed group_by/normalize logic.
omar: If it's group_by we might be dropping percentile keys. Check the TSDB query — maybe we aggregated on "stat" label and p95/p99 were renamed to "p95.0" vs "p99.0" after normalization.
sre_oncall: Running quick query against metrics-store:
```
GET /query?metric=latency.gateway_api&group_by=route,stat
# result: series for stat in [p50,p90] only, p95/p99 missing
```
sre_oncall: Logs from aggregation job around 1776542800 show:
```
WARN metrics-agg: null series for stat=p99 route=/v1/complete
DEBUG metrics-agg: normalize_tags dropped label 'stat' when value contains '.'
```
devops: We rotated the aggregator config earlier — config change: metrics.normalize_strip_dots=true. That was meant for elastic tag compatibility. :grimacing:
liam: Oof. So p95/p99 had dots and got stripped -> they collapsed into other series or got removed? Need clarity on exact symptom.
nisha: Yes, code removes keys with dots; I added that to avoid ES tag collisions. Didn't think about percentile labels. I'll revert in a hotfix.
support_lead: FYI — 3 escalations opened from customers: TKT-3421, TKT-3423, TKT-3426. Marking P1. Please include a short status message we can send to customers.
emma: Quick mitigation: re-run aggregation for last 3 hours with normalize_strip_dots=false then backfill dashboards. I have a backfill script ready.
omar: Suggested hotfix steps:
1) revert config flag on aggregator
2) restart aggregator job on canary
3) run backfill script:
```
./tools/metrics_backfill --from 1776540000 --to 1776546800 --metrics latency.gateway_api
```
4) invalidate dashboard cache (console:admin -> cache flush)
nisha: I opened PR #8791 to remove dot-stripping for stat keys and added unit tests. Deploying patch to canary now.
sre_oncall: After rolling the canary patch on canary cluster (rolled at 1776545400) I see p95/p99 reappear for gateway-api on staging dashboards. Monitoring for 2x successful runs before promoting. :thumbsup:
support_lead: Draft customer message: "We're investigating missing p95/p99 lines in the latency dashboard after a deploy earlier today. Root cause is a metrics normalization change — we've deployed a fix and are backfilling missing series; expected visible in dashboards within ~30-45 minutes. We'll update you when complete." Approve?
emma: Approve. Send.
liam: Postmortem action items: add e2e test to preserve percentile labels through normalization, add alert if a service loses >2 percentile series in a 5m window, and add a checklist for config flag changes. Filing PMM ticket.
sre_oncall: Last check at 1776546800 — dashboards showing tails back, backfill finished. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
